prompt:
透明背景。Draw ONE NEW complete whole-body arcade pixel sprite of Ultraman Arc LUNA ARMOR. Fixed side-view camera. The character FACES SCREEN RIGHT and WALKS BACKWARD toward SCREEN LEFT. One person, one animation phase.
Image 1 is the complete new backward-walk POSE GUIDE. Image 2 is the accepted exact IDENTITY MASTER: armor, red/silver suit, body proportions and pixel finish. Follow image 1's new absolute pose, not the standing stance in image 2. Neither reference is a forward-walk character animation frame.
The WHITE guide chain is the NEAR LEFT leg/arm, closer to camera, always BRIGHT SILVER. The DARK guide chain is the FAR RIGHT leg/arm, behind in depth, always DARK SILVER. Keep each continuous hip-knee-ankle chain connected to its OWN foot. Do not recolor the legs when their screen positions exchange. Both boots/toes point right while the body steps backward left.
REQUIRED BACKWARD-WALK PHASE 06: BACKWARD PASSING B: The DARK FAR leg supports directly UNDER the pelvis with its whole boot planted. The BRIGHT NEAR leg bends and lifts UNDER the pelvis, passing in front of the far support leg in camera depth. Both ankles are approximately vertically aligned beneath the hips; the bright ankle and ENTIRE bright sole are above the dark support sole. This is the opposite support/color identity from phase02. Do not keep the bright leg stretched forward and do not put the dark foot in the air.
BOTH ARMS AND SHOULDERS MUST TRANSITION: RISING MEDIUM GUARD: both elbows bend and both fists rise only to abdomen/lower-chest height. The near circular wrist disk comes beside the lower ribs and its fist moves forward near the upper abdomen; the far forearm is bent forward with its fist near the upper abdomen. Coordinate shoulders, chest and hips, without the near hand alone moving while the far arm stays frozen.
Keep full natural limb lengths, the same complete body size and coherent hip/chest/shoulder weight transfer. Do not shrink the body or shorten a leg to fit the crossing. Keep the head upright and the pelvis near the guide's stable center. The guide is a planned pose, not final art; do not draw guide marks or ground lines.
Luna identity: low silver swept head crest with its opening, yellow eye, cyan chest lamp, blue moon armor on shoulders/chest, one circular cyan wrist disk on EACH actual forearm, and continuous red/silver suit. Preserve original armor segmentation. Natural continuous suit surfaces at shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles: no toy ball joints, insertion gaps, screws, plastic seams or stand.
Crisp limited 32-color arcade pixel clusters, stepped dark contour, upper-left light. True RGBA transparent PNG. Keep the complete head, feet, hands and all armor tips inside clear transparent margins. No photo, blur, vector rendering, background, cast shadow, text, guide lines, grid, skeleton, extra people, weapons, beam, glow or Q/charge effects. Redraw the ENTIRE person together. No limb cutting, rotating, swapping, mirroring, pasted parts or reuse of another action's person frame.
scale_policy: 同模型统一整图尺度；返图后按实际髋/实体鞋底注册；不复用旧逐相面积倍率
